newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint closes year static vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint closes year static vs dollar.

text.p: 1220 GMT - Hungary's forint closed the final 1996 session of Budapest's interbank forex market virtually unchanged against the dollar in thin trade, dealers said on Tuesday.
* The forint stood at 161.45/55 to the dollar, compared with its opening of 161.45/65.
* The market will be closed on Wednesday but will reopen on Thursday, January 2.
* Traders said they expect the market to gear up to full speed only from January 6.
